I can’t process a refund or grant a free year of Studio directly, and I shouldn’t pretend those actions are complete. What I can do is give you a clear, concise handoff summary you can review and send (via the Question/Problem/Feedback form if you’re signed‑in, or the support mail/Google link if you’re not). Use the form or link below, and include only the facts that are true and still relevant.

— Handoff summary (editable) —
I’m requesting:
1) a refund
2) a free year of Studio

Please use a resource that is verified and human‑reviewed, so finance can approve it correctly. If you’re signed‑in, open the shared Question/Problem/Feedback form at [INSERT THE FEEDBACK URL ETC], then paste these points and any supporting details (order IDs, dates, etc.) before sending.

If you prefer email, use the configured support email link and include the same facts.

Any action I relay would be based on an admitted operator who can verify the request and process it once approved. Feedback: [optional]

— End summary —

After you edit it, you can paste that into the feedback form or email. I’d recommend reviewing the summary for completeness and attaching facts (e.g., order IDs) if you have them—that helps avoid back‑and‑forth.

Would you like guidance on navigating to the exact form or link in your account? If so, let me know your app environment and I can walk you through it.
